name: Jean Trémoulet
features: olive skin, dark wavy hair, dark eyes, broad face, heavy brows, stocky build, calm steady expression
bio: Won the 1938 Le Mans 24 Hours with Eugène Chaboud in a privately entered Delahaye 135 CS, the pair nursing a broken gearbox for the last twenty hours with only top gear left to them. He joined the Resistance and was killed in his native Dordogne in October 1944, aged 35.
